By Dhvanil Patel, adapting Swarm by Joel Califa:
https://github.com/califa/swarm-site

The upstream repository currently supplies no license and asks users to consult
Joel Califa before reusing the code. This notice does not grant redistribution
rights. Public redistribution requires resolving that with the authors.

Portfolio changes are limited to startup options, no-intro homepage mounting,
automatic tour/exit, a Pause control, responsive HUD styling, cursor budgets
for desktop/phone, a strict spawn cap, concurrent worker counts and cleanup hooks.
The snapshot renderer, task generators, cursor physics, guides, duplication,
text editing, image drawing and sound engine are upstream's implementation.
